# Data

RBB-GALLERY reads static data and media shipped with the repository. It does not connect to a database, cloud storage account, or Snowflake.

## Databases

None. The repository contains no SQL client, database configuration, schema project, or database access.

## Storage accounts

None are configured. The static JSON and image files below are repository assets served by the public static host; no separate account, container, queue, table, or file share is identified. The app reads these files and does not write them.

| Repository data | Contents and use | Access |
|---|---|---|
| `deck/assets/art/manifest.json` | Artwork identifiers, artist/title/year, image paths, source catalogue references, and dimensions; loaded for the collection artwork field ([manifest.json:1-18](../deck/assets/art/manifest.json#L1-L18), [presentation.js:116-125](../deck/src/presentation.js#L116-L125)). | Same-origin static fetch; read |
| `deck/assets/projects/cover-manifest.json` | Project IDs, titles, local image paths, dimensions, Clayco source URLs, and alt text; loaded for the project cover ([cover-manifest.json:1-19](../deck/assets/projects/cover-manifest.json#L1-L19), [project-field.js:4-16](../deck/src/project-field.js#L4-L16)). | Same-origin static fetch; read |
| `deck/assets/projects/projects.json` | Project details, locations, significance/scope, images, source URLs, and grouped project members; loaded by the project details module ([seminal-projects.js:14-17](../deck/src/seminal-projects.js#L14-L17)). | Same-origin static fetch; read |
| Browser `sessionStorage` and URL hash | Current scene identifier, for reload recovery and navigation; no server-side write ([presentation.js:192-212](../deck/src/presentation.js#L192-L212)). | Browser-local; read/write for the current browsing session |

## Snowflake

This repository does not connect to Snowflake. No service account, signed-in Entra identity, Snowflake target, or queryable database objects are present.

The app's static media includes artwork and project photographs/renderings. The source does not identify a personal-data processing workflow or backend data store.
